verdict.rationale: The docs suggest a shared connection model: transaction data requires linking the customer 'to at least one account via Connect', and account ownership is retrieved 'from a connected account'. Balance, ACH details, and aggregation are also exposed as separate services run against the customer's FI accounts. Taken together, this implies one Connect-linked account can feed several data products, but nothing explicitly says a single Connect session covers auth, balances, transactions, and identity without re-linking per product. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that one Connect session serves multiple products, documentation of how product scopes or permissions are set at link time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
